# dayloop v0.12.0-rc6 — calendar and Confidant progress review build

This prerelease is an installable candidate for checking the refined P5R Calendar, Today cleanup, game-picker order, and task-driven Confidant ranks on a real device.

## What changed since rc5

- Centered every Calendar month/year plate uniformly and removed variable empty background width.
- Ordered the game picker as Persona 5 Royal, Persona 3 Reload, then Metaphor: ReFantazio through pack-authored ordering metadata.
- Shortened the Perfect Day hold to 1.25 seconds.
- Removed both P5R section markers from the Calendar, media manifest, and APK assets.
- Doubled deadline-pin artwork to 32 dp and anchored it over the top-right of due-date cells.
- Applied upright condensed display type to P5R weekday abbreviations and date numbers without changing the month/year header style.
- Added a red TODAY plate to the active Calendar date.
- Swapped the Today footer controls so Undo day is left and End day is right.
- Removed the trailing “finish the heist beforehand” copy from Today heist deadline titles.
- Removed duplicate “Class question” wording from daily answer cards.
- Derived Confidant rank progress automatically from Done rank-milestone tasks and surfaced it in both the list and detail ladder.

## What to check

- Compare Aug 2016, Sep 2016, Oct 2016, and Feb 2017: the month plate should hug its text and remain centered between the arrows.
- Confirm every due-date pin is large, top-right, and allowed to overhang its day cell; no section marker should appear anywhere.
- Confirm weekday labels read Mon through Sun in the upright display face, date numbers use the same family, and the current date carries a red TODAY plate.
- Open the game picker and verify P5R, P3R, Metaphor order.
- Complete a task containing “Confidant reaches rank N”; verify the Confidants list and detail page update, then clear/skip it and verify progress rolls back.
- Check a class-question day and a heist deadline day for the duplicate/suffix cleanup.
- Confirm Perfect Day clears after about 1.25 seconds and the Today footer reads Undo day on the left, End day on the right.

## Candidate APK notes

- This APK is **not production-signed**. It uses Android's standard debug signing key for hands-on testing.
- Its application id is `com.shadowmonarchbooks.dayloop.candidate`, so it can be installed alongside the production Dayloop app.
- Its profiles, progress, and settings are separate from the stable app.
- Version: `0.12.0-rc6` (`versionCode 19`).

_Fan-made tool, not affiliated with or endorsed by ATLUS/SEGA._
